title: ROS 2 discovery troubleshooting
keywords: discovery multicast peers subnet ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE ROS_STATIC_PEERS see each other machine machines network firewall
text: ROS 2 discovery can be constrained by discovery-range and static-peer settings. Review localhost-only restrictions, networks, firewall policies, configured discovery peers, and ROS_DOMAIN_ID on both sides.
